description: Phat hien MISSING business logic ma static probes khong the thay: cross-module pattern gaps (module A co feature X nhung module B cung domain lai thieu), domain-specific mandatory fields/rules chua implement, requirements registry co nhung code chua implement. 100% LLM (3-pass analysis). Khac biet voi QD1-QD10: khong tim BUG trong code hien tai, ma tim LOGIC CHUA CO.

quick.notes: QD11 SKIP hoan toan trong quick profile — LLM-heavy completeness analysis khong phu hop voi quick scan. Lane status = skipped + ly do.

standard.notes: 2 probes: cross-module comparison + registry gap. Bo qua domain heuristic (can domain references files).

deep.notes: All 3 probes. Domain heuristic can .claude/references/team-expert/ (graceful skip neu thieu).

exhaustive.notes: All 3 probes voi full depth. Domain heuristic bat buoc khi co domain references.

high_triggers: Feature ton tai trong module A nhung thieu trong module B cung domain (MISSING_FEATURE)
Requirement trong registry, impl_status=not_started, nhung lien quan den scope (UNIMPLEMENTED_REQ)
Domain compliance check bat buoc nhung chua implement (MISSING_COMPLIANCE_CHECK)
Business rule dac thu domain khong co validation (MISSING_BUSINESS_RULE)
medium_triggers: Field ton tai trong reference module nhung thieu trong target (MISSING_FIELD)
Cung field name nhung khac type giua cac module (TYPE_MISMATCH)
Requirement trong registry, impl_status=done, nhung khong tim thay annotation (ORPHAN_REQ_ID)
Thieu audit trail cho business event (MISSING_AUDIT_TRAIL)
low_triggers: Reference module co validation nhung target khong co (VALIDATION_GAP)

dependencies._agents_note: Domain expert agents duoc resolve dynamic theo registry.departments[] (vd: healthcare-expert, finance-expert, logistics-expert). Fallback: business-analyst.

execution_rationale: Pass 1 (cross-module) + Pass 3 (registry gap) chay PARALLEL truoc — ca 2 deu la static analysis tren registry+code, khong phu thuoc nhau. Pass 2 (domain heuristic) chay sau — can ket qua domain reference lookup + co the cross-reference voi Pass 1 signals.

skip_conditions.single_module: Project chi co 1 module — khong the cross-reference giua cac module cung domain
skip_conditions.api_only: interface_type=api-only — khong co UI de so sanh entity forms/lists/workflows
skip_conditions.profile_quick: Profile quick — skip LLM-heavy completeness analysis, chi phu hop standard+
